\chapter{Asking the Way}
\label{ch:ka-asking-the-way}
\hlchaptermodality{313}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can ask how to get somewhere with … hēge hōgabēku? and how far it is, and give the way with nēravāgi, eḍakke, balakke and pakkadalli.}

Complete the last lesson of chapter 313: ask the way and how far it is, and give the way back.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಹೇಗೆ} \kn{ಹೋಗಬೇಕು}? (hēge hōgabēku?)}{ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋಗಬೇಕು? (hēge hōgabēku?)}]{\kn{ಹೇಗೆ} \kn{ಹೋಗಬೇಕು}? (hēge hōgabēku?) — asking the way}

\label{lesson:KA-C313-hege-hogabeku}



\begin{quote}
Say \textquotedblleft{}where?\textquotedblright{} (\emph{elli}) and \textquotedblleft{}how?\textquotedblright{} (\emph{hēge}). Then \textquotedblleft{}I must go early tomorrow.\textquotedblright{} (\emph{nānu nāḷe bēga hōgabēku}.)
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಹೇಗೆ} \kn{ಹೋಗಬೇಕು}? and \kn{ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ}?}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\kn{ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ}, \kn{ಬಸ್} \kn{ನಿಲ್ದಾಣಕ್ಕೆ} \kn{ಹೇಗೆ} \kn{ಹೋಗಬೇಕು}?}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kṣamisi, bas nildāṇakke hēge hōgabēku?} — \textquotedblleft{}Excuse me, how do I get to the bus station?\textquotedblright{}
\end{quote}

Word for word it is \textquotedblleft{}how must (one) go to the bus station\textquotedblright{}, with the \textbf{-\kn{ಬೇಕು}} of \textquotedblleft{}must\textquotedblright{}. The place takes the \textquotedblleft{}to\textquotedblright{} ending: \textbf{\kn{ನಿಲ್ದಾಣಕ್ಕೆ}}, \textbf{\kn{ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ}}. \textbf{\kn{ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ}}, \textquotedblleft{}sorry\textquotedblright{}, opens the question politely, the way English says \textquotedblleft{}excuse me\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\kn{ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ} \kn{ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ}?}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āspatre ellide?} — \textquotedblleft{}Where is the hospital?\textquotedblright{}
\end{quote}

\textbf{\kn{ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ}} is \textbf{\kn{ಎಲ್ಲಿ}}, \textquotedblleft{}where\textquotedblright{}, run together with \textbf{\kn{ಇದೆ}}, \textquotedblleft{}is\textquotedblright{}.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: how far}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\kn{ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ} \kn{ಎಷ್ಟು} \kn{ದೂರ}?}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{illinda eṣṭu dūra?} — \textquotedblleft{}How far is it from here?\textquotedblright{}
\end{quote}

\textbf{\kn{ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ}} is \textbf{\kn{ಇಲ್ಲಿ}}, \textquotedblleft{}here\textquotedblright{}, with \textbf{-\kn{ಇಂದ}}, \textquotedblleft{}from\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\kn{ಎಷ್ಟು} \kn{ದೂರ}} is \textquotedblleft{}how much distance\textquotedblright{}. The answers:

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\kn{ಹತ್ತಿರ} \kn{ಇದೆ}.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{hattira ide.} — \textquotedblleft{}It's near.\textquotedblright{}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\kn{ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ} \kn{ದೂರ} \kn{ಇದೆ}.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{svalpa dūra ide.} — \textquotedblleft{}It's a little far.\textquotedblright{}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \textquotedblleft{}Excuse me, how do I get to the bus station?\textquotedblright{} — \emph{kṣamisi, bas nildāṇakke hēge hōgabēku?}
  \item \textquotedblleft{}How far is it from here?\textquotedblright{} — \emph{illinda eṣṭu dūra?}
  \item \textquotedblleft{}It's near\textquotedblright{} — \emph{hattira ide}
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
\textquotedblleft{}How do I get to the station?\textquotedblright{} (\textbf{\kn{ನಿಲ್ದಾಣಕ್ಕೆ} \kn{ಹೇಗೆ} \kn{ಹೋಗಬೇಕು}?}) \textquotedblleft{}Where is it?\textquotedblright{} (\textbf{\kn{ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ}?}) \textquotedblleft{}From here\textquotedblright{}? (\textbf{\kn{ಇಲ್ಲಿಂದ}}.) \textquotedblleft{}How far?\textquotedblright{} (\textbf{\kn{ಎಷ್ಟು} \kn{ದೂರ}?})
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ನೇರವಾಗಿ} \kn{ಹೋಗಿ} (nēravāgi hōgi)}{ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಹೋಗಿ (nēravāgi hōgi)}]{\kn{ನೇರವಾಗಿ} \kn{ಹೋಗಿ} (nēravāgi hōgi) — giving the way}

\label{lesson:KA-C313-neravagi-hogi}



\begin{quote}
Say \textquotedblleft{}left\textquotedblright{}, \textquotedblleft{}right\textquotedblright{} and \textquotedblleft{}straight\textquotedblright{}. (\emph{eḍa}, \emph{bala}, \emph{nēra}.) Then \textquotedblleft{}How far is it from here?\textquotedblright{} (\emph{illinda eṣṭu dūra?})
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: straight on, left, right}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\kn{ನೇರವಾಗಿ} \kn{ಹೋಗಿ}. \kn{ಮೊದಲ} \kn{ತಿರುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ} \kn{ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ} \kn{ಹೋಗಿ}.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nēravāgi hōgi. modala tiruvinalli eḍakke hōgi.} — \textquotedblleft{}Go straight on. At the first turn, go left.\textquotedblright{}
\end{quote}

\textbf{\kn{ಹೋಗಿ}} here is a polite \textquotedblleft{}go\textquotedblright{}: the same \textbf{-\kn{ಇ}} form as \textquotedblleft{}having gone\textquotedblright{}, said to a listener, as in \textbf{\kn{ಫೋನ್} \kn{ಮಾಡಿ}}, \textquotedblleft{}please phone\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\kn{ನೇರವಾಗಿ}} is \textbf{\kn{ನೇರ}} with \textbf{-\kn{ವಾಗಿ}}, the piece you met in \textbf{\kn{ಸ್ವಚ್ಛವಾಗಿದೆ}}: \textquotedblleft{}straight on\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{\kn{ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ}} is \textbf{\kn{ಎಡ}} with \textbf{-\kn{ಕ್ಕೆ}}, \textquotedblleft{}to\textquotedblright{}: \textquotedblleft{}to the left\textquotedblright{}; and \textbf{\kn{ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ}} (\emph{balakke}), \textquotedblleft{}to the right\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\kn{ಮೊದಲ}} (\emph{modala}, \textquotedblleft{}first\textquotedblright{}) is the \textbf{\kn{ಮೊದಲು}} of a story, standing in front of a noun. \textbf{\kn{ತಿರುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ}} (\emph{tiruvinalli}, \textquotedblleft{}at the turn\textquotedblright{}) is \textbf{\kn{ತಿರುವು}} with \textbf{-\kn{ಇನ}-} and \textbf{-\kn{ಅಲ್ಲಿ}}, \textquotedblleft{}at\textquotedblright{}.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: what it is next to}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\kn{ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ} \kn{ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ} \kn{ಇದೆ}, \kn{ಅಂಗಡಿಯ} \kn{ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ}.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āspatre balakke ide, aṅgaḍiya pakkadalli.} — \textquotedblleft{}The hospital is on the right, next to the shop.\textquotedblright{}
\end{quote}

\textbf{\kn{ಅಂಗಡಿಯ}} (\emph{aṅgaḍiya}, \textquotedblleft{}of the shop\textquotedblright{}); \textbf{\kn{ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ}} (\emph{pakkadalli}, \textquotedblleft{}at the side, next to\textquotedblright{}), from \textbf{\kn{ಪಕ್ಕ}}. Most directions are these few pieces in a row: straight on, a turn, left or right, and one thing it is next to.

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\kn{ಬಸ್} \kn{ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ} \kn{ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ} \kn{ಇದೆ}, \kn{ಹೋಟೆಲ್} \kn{ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ}.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{bas nildāṇa eḍakke ide, hōṭel pakkadalli.} — \textquotedblleft{}The bus station is on the left, next to the hotel.\textquotedblright{}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \textquotedblleft{}Go straight on. At the first turn, go left.\textquotedblright{} — \emph{nēravāgi hōgi. modala tiruvinalli eḍakke hōgi.}
  \item \textquotedblleft{}Go to the right\textquotedblright{} — \emph{balakke hōgi}
  \item \textquotedblleft{}The hospital is on the right, next to the shop\textquotedblright{} — \emph{āspatre balakke ide, aṅgaḍiya pakkadalli}
  \item the way from your door to the nearest shop, in three steps
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
\textquotedblleft{}Straight on\textquotedblright{}? (\textbf{\kn{ನೇರವಾಗಿ}}.) \textquotedblleft{}To the left\textquotedblright{}? (\textbf{\kn{ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ}}.) \textquotedblleft{}To the right\textquotedblright{}? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ}}.) \textquotedblleft{}At the first turn\textquotedblright{}? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೊದಲ} \kn{ತಿರುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ}}.) \textquotedblleft{}Next to the shop\textquotedblright{}? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಂಗಡಿಯ} \kn{ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(review)]{Review — asking the way}

\label{lesson:KA-R313-asking-the-way}



\begin{quote}
Read \textbf{\kn{ಸ್ವಚ್ಛ}} aloud, and name its small letter. (\emph{svaccha}; \textbf{\kn{ಛ}}.) Then \textquotedblleft{}You should see a doctor.\textquotedblright{} (\emph{nīvu vaidyarannu nōḍabēku}.)
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item Excuse me, where is the station? How far is it from here?
  \item It's near. Go straight on, then go right at the first turn.
  \item The hotel is on the left, next to the hospital.
  \item You must not go that way, because there is no path.
  \item ask the way to a shop, then give the answer yourself
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
\textquotedblleft{}How do I get to …?\textquotedblright{} (\textbf{… }\kn{ಹೇಗೆ} \kn{ಹೋಗಬೇಕು}?\textbf{\emph{}) \textquotedblleft{}How far?\textquotedblright{} (}\kn{ಎಷ್ಟು} \kn{ದೂರ}?\textbf{) \textquotedblleft{}Go straight on\textquotedblright{}? (}\kn{ನೇರವಾಗಿ} \kn{ಹೋಗಿ}\textbf{.) \textquotedblleft{}Next to\textquotedblright{}? (}\kn{ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ}\textbf{.)}
\end{tcolorbox}
